'''Ocanis Gas''' was a gas trading company.

On the rescue of [[Emon Azzameen]], ''[[Otana/Legends|Otana]]'' approached [[Quesna Base]] under the guise of Ocanis Gas ship that delivered [[Tibanna/Legends|tibanna]] the facility had ordered.
